title: CASE/LRMI alignment metadata emitter + validator
context: Interoperability is a core goal of this project: lesson plans must be importable into LMS systems, discoverable by search engines, and usable by OER repositories. This requires machine-readable metadata: LRMI / schema.org LearningResource + alignmentObject for discoverability, and CASE (1EdTech Competencies & Academic Standards Exchange) format for standards alignment. Without an emitter that generates these from the canonical Markdown + YAML front-matter, every plan requires manual metadata work that is error-prone and blocks LMS import and repository acceptance. This task builds the metadata emitter and validator that all subsequent plan-authoring and export tasks depend on.
objective: Implement a metadata emitter that reads a plan's YAML front-matter and produces valid LRMI/schema.org LearningResource + alignmentObject JSON-LD and a CASE-compatible standards alignment document, plus a validator that checks them against the relevant specs.
acceptanceCriteria: The emitter reads a lesson plan's YAML front-matter (standards[] field per the alignment model in teacher-lesson-plans-standards-004) and produces a schema.org/LRMI LearningResource JSON-LD document with at least: name, description, educationalLevel, educationalAlignment (alignmentObject entries for each standard).
The emitter produces a CASE-compatible alignment document (or CASE association records) for each standards[] entry, using the framework code and identifier from the plan's alignment model.
A validator runs in CI to confirm the emitted LRMI JSON-LD and CASE documents are structurally valid against the pinned spec versions (recorded in a specVersions file committed to the repo).
The emitter is integrated into the CI pipeline and runs on every plan PR; failed validation fails the build.
Code is MIT-licensed; golden-fixture tests (input plan → expected LRMI/CASE output) are committed; pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass; no credentials embedded.
resources: teacher-lesson-plans-standards-004 — standards-alignment model (defines the input schema)
teacher-lesson-plans-validator-006 — existing schema validator (to integrate with)
output: A merged PR adding a CASE/LRMI metadata emitter and validator to the CI pipeline, with golden fixtures and a committed specVersions file recording the pinned LRMI and CASE spec versions.
